name: Stein Eriksen Residences Deer Valley
insider_take: Named after Norwegian Olympic ski champion Stein Eriksen, this mountain retreat sits at 8,100 feet elevation where champagne powder snow and European alpine elegance create pure luxury.
whats_special: These spacious residences offer true ski-in/ski-out access to Deer Valley's pristine slopes, which famously limit daily skier numbers to ensure uncrowded runs. The resort sits on the same mountain where the 2002 Winter Olympics slalom and freestyle events took place, and maintains the area's reputation as one of America's most exclusive ski destinations.
pro_tip: Book your stay during January for the best powder conditions and fewer crowds, plus take advantage of the complimentary shuttle service to nearby Park City's historic Main Street for après-ski dining and shopping.
dont_miss: The Royal Street Café's famous turkey chili and fresh-baked cookies served slope-side, plus sunset views from your private balcony overlooking the Wasatch Mountains. Deer Valley's legendary ski valets will even carry your equipment and help with your boots – service that's become synonymous with the resort's white-glove approach.
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out location at prestigious Deer Valley Resort
Spacious luxury residences with full kitchens and multiple bedrooms
High-end amenities including heated outdoor pool and spa services
Stunning mountain views and upscale Nordic-inspired design
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury resort positioning
Seasonal availability primarily during ski season
